decision: The crosstree dream backs up each tree it writes with store_manifest.py backup --scope tree and verifies against it before the report, printing the pointer-block cost lines.

evidence.text: grep: neither crosstree skill named store_manifest before this change; contract test test_every_dream_backs_up_and_verifies_with_store_manifest.

reopen_if: store_manifest.py is replaced, or stops copying every in-scope CLAUDE.local.md.
why: A hand-rolled snapshot has no manifest, so the run that adds the most pointers to tree tops could not be verified or costed.

anchors: A second tree never reuses a backup dir
decision: Each tree's step 1 backup goes to its own --out dir, ~/.claude/self-improve-audit/backups/crosstree-<name of that tree's anchor dir>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>, a number added when two anchors share a name; a second tree never reuses a backup dir.

evidence.text: RED (opus, pre-edit step 1): <key> NONE, consequence of sharing NONE; GREEN (opus and haiku): crosstree-alpha-20261110-1405 and crosstree-beta-20261110-1407, sharing refused with the replace consequence quoted. _check_out read: an earlier backup dir is accepted and cleared.

reopen_if: store_manifest.py backup refuses an --out that holds a backup of a different anchor, so a shared dir can no longer replace another tree's backup.
why: store_manifest.py backup accepts an earlier backup dir as --out and clears its store/ and levels/ before copying (_check_out), so a second tree backed up into the first tree's dir replaces the first tree's only restore source with exit 0.

anchors: A relocate whose target level is that tree's TOP is a misplacement re-home to the tree top
decision: A step 4b relocate whose target level is that tree's top is a misplacement re-home to the tree top: the report lists it with its cost (the bytes it adds to the top block, the UTF-8 length of its pointer line plus the newline), proposed in propose and applied in auto, per dream-core's Mode.

evidence.text: user decision 2026-11-10 'Misplacements only'; RED (opus, pre-edit 4b): cost NONE; GREEN (opus and haiku): proposed with the UTF-8 pointer-line cost quoted.

reopen_if: dream-core's Mode stops treating a misplacement re-home to the tree top differently from a re-home below it.
why: The dream-core report contract wants every move to a tree top listed with its cost, and the user decision of 2026-11-10 ('Misplacements only') puts a misplacement re-home to the top under the dream mode; step 4b's relocate was the one crosstree path that could land a misplacement at a top with no cost line.

anchors: A 4b relocate is an expected difference
decision: Step 8 treats a 4b relocate as an expected verify difference: removed in its source tree's verify, added in its target tree's.

evidence.text: RED (opus, pre-edit step 8): classed the removal as a decided move only by its own reading of the category list, gap reported; GREEN (opus and haiku): expected difference, sentence quoted.

reopen_if: verify runs across trees and reports a relocate as one moved entry.
why: Each tree is verified against its own backup, so a correct relocate reads as a removal in one tree and an addition in another; without the sentence step 8's 'or a loss to explain' sends the reader after a loss that is a decided move.

decision: Not adopted: stating an `off` behaviour (proposed under off) for a step 4b relocate to a tree top.

evidence.text: SKILL.md Mode: '`off` skips this skill entirely'; re-probe on the final text (opus and haiku): step 4b does not run under off, no contradiction left between Mode and 4b.

reopen_if: The crosstree dream starts running under dream_mode off.
why: The skill's Mode section says `off` skips this skill entirely, so a clause about what 4b does under off describes a run that never happens and reads as a contradiction (a GREEN probe reported it as one).

anchors: A fact lifted or copied into another tree arrives UNTAGGED
decision: A fact lifted, copied or relocated into another tree arrives without topics and is not tagged by the crosstree run; the target tree's own dream tags it against that tree's list.

evidence.text: Scratch trees 2026-11-12: add of a new fact whose body file carried 'topics: [python]' printed "! refused: '<slug>' has no body file yet and the body given carries a frontmatter topics: line"; relocate of a universal fact printed '~ note: dropped the topics: line of <slug> - topics are tagged against one tree's list; tag it in the target tree with set-topics' and the target body had no topics line.

reopen_if: Topic lists become shared between trees.
why: Topics are tagged against one tree's closed list, and tagging is the tree dream's routed judgement, not a side effect of a transfer.

anchors: judge and report it as ONE fact
decision: A misfiled fact that is placed by topic is one candidate although the audit lists it once per level; relocate refuses it, so when the relocate is applied it is un-bound in its source tree with set-topics --clear first and relocated from the level the audit names on a second run; in propose mode the un-bind is part of the proposal and is not run.

evidence.text: Scratch trees 2026-11-12: --check-misplaced listed one placed fact twice with 'TOTAL misplaced: 2'; relocate printed "! refused: '<slug>' is placed by topic: ..."; set-topics --clear printed 'set topics on 1 fact(s); 0 unchanged' and '~ note: 1 un-bound fact(s) had a line at several levels; each now has one line, at the tree top: <slug>'; the audit then named --from-level <anchor>, and the relocate from there succeeded. A placed fact with one line kept its line at its level after --clear.

reopen_if: relocate learns to move a placed fact itself, or --clear stops collapsing lines to the tree top.
why: relocate refuses a placed fact from every level, and --clear leaves a several-line fact with one line at the source tree's top but a one-line fact where it was, so the level cannot be stated as a constant.
